people.name: Carl-Jan Rupp
people.title: Principal
projects: Victoria Fire Station No. 1 & Dalmatian Residences
PEXSISEN Elementary & Centre Mountain Lellum Middle Schools (Sooke SD62)

people.notes: Has managed hcma's Victoria office since 2005; primary principal for all Island civic, rec, and school work. Former Vice-Chair of Saanich Advisory Design Panel. Over $70M in aquatic/sports facility projects on Vancouver Island. Selects structural sub-consultants for each pursuit.

people.name: Adam Fawkes
people.title: Associate Principal

people.notes: 25 years serving Vancouver Island communities; leading expansion of hcma's Victoria office. Named by Central Saanich as hcma's project lead for their new civic/rec/fire/police complex. Specialises in LEED Platinum, Passive House, mixed-use civic buildings.

people.title: Associate Principal

people.notes: Co-leads hcma's K-12 Learning Environments practice. Multiple completed Island schools in Sooke SD62 and Greater Victoria SD61. CPHD and RHFAC credentials.

people.name: Kim Winston
people.title: Associate Principal
projects: K-12 Learning Environments (co-lead with Rance Mok)
Community and recreational facility feasibility and schematic design studies
people.notes: Co-leads hcma's K-12 practice. Speaker at national education design conferences. Key contact on any hcma school board pursuit on Vancouver Island.

people.name: Darryl Condon
people.title: Managing Principal

people.name: Laura Potter

people.title: Principal
